_notes: Iron Man Arena helmet HUD layout. Spec: hud_spec.md (same folder). Element ids == BindWidget names on UHelmetHUDWidget (top level) or on the element's own widget class (children). Positions are in Slate units at the reference resolution; UE DPI scaling converts them. Colours: hex is sRGB RRGGBBAA, linear is FLinearColor (sRGB->linear, alpha linear). Child slot anchors are relative to the parent element. parallaxDepth: 0 = head-locked, 1 = world-locked/maximum lag.

scaling._notes: Project Settings > User Interface: DPI Scale Rule = Shortest Side, curve as listed. Corner modules anchor to screen edges but are clamped inside a centred region no wider than maxContentAspect (43:18 = 21.5:9) for super-ultrawide. Core cluster (tapes, reticle, ladder) stays within a centred 16:9 box.

visorWarp._notes: ChromaticEdgePx is at the 1080p reference; material multiplies by ViewSize.y/1080. ScanlineDensity = lines per screen height.

HUD_Mono._notes: Share Tech Mono has one weight; Bold maps to Regular with outline 0 + 1px shadow, or to Roboto Mono Bold.

fonts._notes: size = UMG font Size (Slate points; ~1.333 px at 96 DPI). letterSpacing = FSlateFontInfo::LetterSpacing (1/1000 em). Fallback = FCoreStyle::GetDefaultFontStyle (Roboto) when the asset is missing.

colorBlindPalette._notes: Okabe-Ito based, used when Settings > Colour-blind safe HUD is on. Warnings always also carry an icon shape and text.

heat._notes: Mirrors UReactorComponent (MaxHeat 100, OverheatRecoverAt 35, VentDuration 1.2, VentCooldown 6, VentCoolingPerSecond 70). Values are heat units = percent of MaxHeat.

bootSequence._notes: Elements fade+scaleY 0.6->1 with a scan line sweep top to bottom.

warningFlash._notes: Rate per warning flashHz; never above thresholds.flashMaxHz.

commsClose._notes: delay = hold after the last subtitle line ends.

personaSwap._notes: Glyph morph: old glyph scales 1->0 (300ms) with a 1-frame glitch, new glyph 0->1 (300ms); palette crossfades in linear space over the full 600ms.

personaSpeakingPulse._notes: Driven by voice envelope (0..1) with 30ms attack, 120ms release.

glitchTear._notes: Per tear; tier 2 repeats every 2-4 s (random), tier 3 every 0.6-1.5 s.

glitchBlackout._notes: Tier 4 only, every 3-6 s; skipped in reduced motion.

lowPowerBrownout._notes: Global HUD opacity dips to 0.75 below power.critical.

accessibility._notes: Defaults; user settings override. reducedMotion zeroes parallax/head-bob/impact kick, replaces tears with a static 0.1 desaturate, caps flashes to steady-on with 1 Hz brightness pulse.
